elements.requirement: The Secretary of State must pay to ACAS such sums as are approved by the Treasury and as the Secretary of State considers appropriate for the purpose of enabling ACAS to perform its functions.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State shall pay to ACAS such sums as are approved by the Treasury and as he considers appropriate for the purpose of enabling ACAS to perform its functions.

elements.requirement: ACAS may pay such fees and travelling and other allowances as are determined by the Secretary of State with the approval of the Treasury to persons appointed under section 210(2) (conciliation) who are not officers or servants of ACAS.
elements.quote: persons appointed under section 210(2) (conciliation) who are not officers or servants of ACAS

elements.requirement: ACAS may pay such fees and travelling and other allowances as are determined by the Secretary of State with the approval of the Treasury to arbitrators or arbiters appointed by ACAS under any enactment.
elements.quote: arbitrators or arbiters appointed by ACAS under any enactment

elements.requirement: Fees and travelling and other allowances payable by ACAS to appointed conciliation persons or arbitrators or arbiters must be determined by the Secretary of State with the approval of the Treasury.
elements.quote: such fees and travelling and other allowances as may be determined by the Secretary of State with the approval of the Treasury
